model: Mooer GE300 parametric EQ (5 fixed bells)

global_gain.note: Hardware global control spans -60..+3 dB and adds directly to the response. Operational presets currently lock +3 dB; free search over the full range is supported by the model API.

sources.role: canonical numeric constants for this package
historical declaration of gain_effective_coefficient=0.75 and Q law

uncertainty.note: SDs are scenario values carried from the reconstruction audit, not a fresh laboratory calibration of this specific GE300.

honesty: gain_coeff=0.75 is an inherited calibrated coefficient, not re-derived in this repository from a swept unit measurement. Changing it requires a new hashed provenance entry.
